claim: Normal VECTOR sign-in is passkey-first and does not render password content; the local sealed candidate accepts a verified ES256 passkey assertion once.

observations: Executed company-ui.js rendered a populated password input in the normal sign-in view.
POST /api/passkeys/register/options returned 404 because no passkey ceremony existed.

repair.normalSignIn: Passkey-only UI; no password field or password wording is rendered.
repair.credential: P-256 / ES256 public-key credential stored per account.
repair.registration: Existing authenticated session, exact origin, RP ID hash, user-presence and user-verification flags, one-time challenge, and session binding are required.
repair.authentication: Exact origin, RP ID hash, user-presence and user-verification flags, ES256 signature, one-time challenge, and monotonic non-zero authenticator counter are checked.
repair.audit: Credential identifiers are hashed before passkey registration/authentication audit events.
repair.runtimeIntegration: The hardener is wired into both the discarded proof stage and final candidate image construction.

observations: The executed normal sign-in UI contains no password text or password input and offers Continue with passkey.
A hostile Origin was rejected with HTTP 403.
An assertion without the user-verification flag was rejected with HTTP 403.
An independently generated and signed P-256 assertion created an authenticated session.
Exact assertion replay was rejected after the one-time challenge was consumed.

releaseGate.reason: This is local synthetic proof only. Existing accounts have no proven passwordless enrollment, recovery, credential replacement/revocation, or hosted ceremony on the exact deployed build. The legacy password API remains available solely as a migration bootstrap and has not been retired.
releaseGate.nextProof: Build and adversarially verify a no-password enrollment/recovery ceremony with independent approval, then execute register -> sign out -> passkey sign in -> refresh/new login in the approved hosted environment on the exact build.
